table.name: TLGNC_WAGON_DMGCODE_TYPE
table.description: Table to store damage codes for a wagon. The damage codes are ment to be attached to the repair order, technically copied over to TLGNC_ORDER_REP_DMGCODE_TYPE when the repair order is created. The damage codes belonging to the wagon are going to be deleted when a repair order (tlgnc_order.DISTRIBUTION_DEST_CD = REP) is set to delivered.

column.name: DMGCODE_TYPE_ID
column.description: The which damage code this belongs to.

column.name: WAGON_ID
column.description: FK to TLGNC_WAGON. The wagon to which the damage code belongs to.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
